walkthroughs.body_html:
Steps after a crime:

  • Police investigate and may arrest.
  • The Crown Prosecution Service decides whether to charge.
  • The court hears the case.

Magistrates' courts handle small cases.

Crown Court handles serious cases with a jury of 12 ordinary citizens.

Sentences include:

  • Fines.
  • Community service.
  • Suspended sentence.
  • Prison.

Rehabilitation tries to help offenders change. Some prisons offer education and work programmes. 📚
